context: Ren interviews a chemist about oil research.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: science interview; vocabulary (化学/石油/統合/合併/配信) in natural home.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 化学の研究、どんな内容ですか?
lines.en: What does your chemistry research involve?
lines.style: engaged young interviewer voice, soft warm curious focus throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 石油に代わる素材を、研究しています。
lines.en: I research materials to replace oil.
lines.style: composed chemist voice, soft warm measured clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 複数の研究を、統合するんですか?
lines.style: curious young interviewer voice, soft warm focus throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ええ、知見を統合して進めます。
lines.en: Yes, we integrate findings to proceed.
lines.style: patient chemist voice, soft warm measured clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 研究所同士の合併も、ありますか?
lines.en: Are there mergers between institutes too?
lines.style: engaged young interviewer voice, soft warm focus throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 合併で、化学の力が集まります。
lines.style: composed chemist voice, soft warm measured clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 成果は、どこで配信されますか?
lines.style: thoughtful young interviewer voice, soft warm focus throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 論文を、ネットで配信しています。
lines.style: warm chemist voice, soft warm measured closing clarity throughout
